title: Somewhere You're Not Gonna Like
trend: TikTok 'I'm gonna send you somewhere you're not gonna like' (lip-sync about a plan that turned out far worse than expected) — trending across US TikTok in October 2026
youtube_title: When the trail app says it's sending you somewhere you're not gonna like 🍂
description:
Curtis ignored the trail app one time. One time. Now the whole family is touring every place they did not want to see.

#somewhereyourenotgonnalike #fallhike #dadjokes #familyfun #comedy #animation #shorts
tiktok_caption: the trail app said it would send us somewhere we're not gonna like 🍂 it was not lying #somewhereyourenotgonnalike #fallhike #comedy #fyp

lines.text: Okay, phone. Take us to the waterfall. Fastest way.
In two hundred feet, turn left at the big rock.
Nah. I know a shortcut. Going right.
Curtis. I am going to send you somewhere you are not going to like.
Dad. The phone just said your name. Like a teacher.
It's a trail app, Jas. It doesn't have feelings.
Rerouting. With feelings.
Look, a pond! See? Shortcut. Scenic. Peaceful.
You have arrived at the goose pond.
Dad, there are forty geese. And they are all looking at you.
That one is the manager. Do not make eye contact.
Why is it walking toward me with its arms out?
Those are wings. Run, Dad.
Okay. Okay. I lost a shoe. The goose has my shoe.
You did not like it. I told you.
Can you change the voice? It sounds like a substitute teacher on a Monday.
Jasmine.
Oh no. It knows me too.
Rerouting you somewhere you are not going to like. Again.
Welcome to the stairs. Four hundred and thirty seven of them.
Why are there stairs in a forest? Who asked for this?
This is great cardio. I'm great. I'm doing great.
I'm gonna lie down on this step. Just for a year.
Dad, a grandma just passed us. Twice.
She had poles. Poles are cheating.
No, nobody quits. We are a hiking family now.
Since when?
Since the goose took my shoe. It's personal now.
Phone, I would like to go somewhere I am going to like. It has snacks.
You licked my screen this morning, Pretzel.
It looked like a window to a better life.
Rerouting everyone.
You have arrived at the picnic area. A stranger's uncle is teaching line dancing.
No. No, no, no. He made eye contact. He's coming over.
Step, slide, turn, clap. Jas! I'm in the front row!
He is not good. But he is so committed.
The uncle says I'm a natural. He gave me a sticker!
Something is wrong. You are supposed to hate this.
Wait. Supposed to? Who told you to make him hate this?
You did, Jasmine. This morning. You picked the route called make Dad want to go home.
Jas?
Okay, yes. I wanted to be home by noon.
Kiddo, the geese, the stairs, the dancing? Best morning all year.
I have failed. He enjoys everything. He is impossible to ruin.
Fine. Then just take us to the waterfall. Please.
About the waterfall.
It is a drinking fountain. The park just calls it a waterfall.
I already found it. I drank the waterfall.
You know what? Worth it. Best hike ever.
You have one shoe and a sticker.
And a goose who respects me now.
The goose does not respect you. The goose is wearing your shoe.
Same thing. Next weekend, we do it again!
Next weekend, I am sending you somewhere you are really not going to like.
Where?
The mall parking lot. On a Saturday. No open spots. Forever.
No!
